evidence_items.source_quote: However, he was found to have leukopenia and CMV viremia on postoperative day (POD) 38 (307,000 copies/ml) while he was still on VGCV.
The genetic mutation study was notable for UL97 mutation.

rationale: 42-year-old male renal transplant recipient who developed leukopenia and high-level CMV viremia (307,000 copies/mL) on POD 38 with a confirmed UL97 resistance mutation (E1 confirmatory), treated with IV ganciclovir, foscarnet, and leflunomide.

evidence_items.source_quote: He developed CMV viremia (67,000 copies/ml) on POD 373 and was symptomatic with malaise and diarrhea.
The CMV viral load peaked at 214,000 copies/ml on POD 383, and the virus became undetectable on POD 401.

rationale: 34-year-old male simultaneous pancreas-kidney transplant recipient who developed symptomatic CMV viremia (malaise, diarrhea; 67,000 copies/mL peaking at 214,000 copies/mL) on POD 373 (E1 confirmatory), treated with IV ganciclovir, foscarnet, and leflunomide.

evidence_items.source_quote: CMV was first detected on POD 146 when the patient presented with diarrhea and weakness.
UL97 mutation was detected, and leflunomide was started on POD 297.

rationale: 43-year-old male renal transplant recipient who presented with diarrhea, weakness, persistent CMV viremia on POD 146, and detected UL97 resistance mutation (E1 confirmatory), treated with VGCV, leflunomide, and brincidofovir.

evidence_items.source_quote: He received VGCV for CMV prophylaxis but developed leukopenia and CMV viremia while still on VGCV prophylaxis on POD 80.
He was treated with an increased dose of VGCV and was switched to IV GCV treatment on POD 110 when the CMV DNA hybrid capture test results continued to rise.

rationale: 45-year-old male renal transplant recipient who developed leukopenia and rising CMV viremia on CMV DNA hybrid capture testing on POD 80 (E1 confirmatory), treated with VGCV, IV ganciclovir, foscarnet, and leflunomide.

evidence_items.source_quote: Viremia, first detected on POD 458, was accompanied by diarrhea and malaise, and the patient was treated with IV GCV.

Although his viral load improved as estimated by a CMV hybrid capture study, he was unable to eradicate the viremia, and a 2-week course of IV foscarnet was started on POD 595 to achieve viral clearance.

rationale: 51-year-old male SPK transplant recipient who developed symptomatic CMV viremia (diarrhea, malaise) confirmed by CMV hybrid capture study on POD 458 with recurrence on POD 811 (E1 confirmatory), treated with IV ganciclovir, foscarnet, and leflunomide.

evidence_items.source_quote: Immunohistochemistry revealed cells positive for cytomegalovirus and evidence of chronic active crypt-destructive colitis related to cytomegalovirus infection.
Serum CMV was quantitated by PCR and found to be 9561 IU/ml.

rationale: 39-year-old male with primary hypogammaglobulinemia presenting with enteritis/watery ostomy output. Colonic biopsy IHC was positive for cytomegalovirus with chronic active crypt-destructive colitis, and serum CMV PCR was 9561 IU/mL (E1 confirmatory), responding to valganciclovir.

evidence_items.source_quote: A cytomegalovirus (CMV) viraemia of 3974 copies/mL (log10 3.60) was measured in March 2017 together with a colon biopsy that was PCR positive for CMV.
evidence_items.test_name: Blood CMV viral load and colon biopsy CMV PCR

rationale: 8-year-old HIV-infected boy (CD4 59 cells/uL) with Mycobacterium genavense abdominal infection and true CMV coinfection: CMV viremia (3,974 copies/mL) and colon biopsy PCR positive for CMV (E1 confirmatory), treated with IV ganciclovir.

evidence_items.source_quote: Generalized primary cytomegalus virus (CMV) infection was confirmed at the age of 3 months. His health status was complicated by bilateral pneumonia followed by respiratory distress that demanded ventilation support complicated by disseminated intravascular coagulation and septic shock. A 6-week treatment with ganciclovir was introduced.
evidence_items.test_name: Confirmed primary CMV diagnosis with end-organ disease and ganciclovir therapy

rationale: Immunocompromised boy with SAMD9 mutation who had confirmed generalized primary CMV infection at 3 months of age complicated by bilateral pneumonia, hepatopathy, and respiratory failure, treated with 6 weeks of ganciclovir (E2_HIGHLY_SPECIFIC).

evidence_items.source_quote: The early post-transplant period was complicated by mucositis grade III, febrile neutropenia and CMV reactivation on day +20 with good response to ganciclovir therapy.
evidence_items.test_name: Post-HSCT CMV reactivation and ganciclovir response

rationale: Boy with SAMD9 mutation undergoing HSCT at 26 months of age whose early post-transplant course was complicated by CMV reactivation on day +20 with good response to ganciclovir therapy (E2_HIGHLY_SPECIFIC).

evidence_items.source_quote: This was presumably in response to persistently present CMV viremia. However, no functionally responding CMV specific T cells were detected. Minor response restricted to CD8+ IFNg+ producing cell was detected at 8.5 months of age that did not lead to CMV control. CMV reactivation control was restored only at one year of age (PCR CMV negativity).
evidence_items.test_name: Persistent CMV viremia and serial CMV PCR

rationale: Immunological and genetic workup of the SAMD9-mutated child documenting persistent CMV viremia and CMV reactivation with PCR positivity until CMV control was restored at 1 year of age (E1_CONFIRMATORY).

evidence_items.source_quote: An HCMV infection was confirmed because positivity for the specific antibody against HCMV immunoglobulin M and HCMV antigenemia (23 of 48,000 cells were positive) were detected.

rationale: 2-month-old boy with Wiskott-Aldrich syndrome (WASP mutation) and confirmed active CMV coinfection: HCMV IgM positive and significant HCMV antigenemia (23 of 48,000 cells positive; E1 confirmatory), requiring prolonged IV ganciclovir.

evidence_items.source_quote: Cytomegalovirus (CMV) infection was diagnosed at day 80 after transplantation, with the level more than 5x10 Copies/mL, so the patient was treated with ganciclovir.
evidence_items.test_name: Quantitative CMV viral load and ganciclovir therapy

rationale: 51-year-old female post-allo-PBSCT for MDS with acute GVHD who was diagnosed with CMV infection on day 80 post-transplant with elevated CMV viral load (>5x10^x copies/mL) and treated with ganciclovir (E2_HIGHLY_SPECIFIC).

evidence_items.source_quote: Cytomegalovirus (CMV) DNA in peripheral blood was 300,000 copies/ml detected by polymerase reaction (PCR).

rationale: 52-year-old male with Good syndrome (thymoma + hypogammaglobulinemia) on high-dose methylprednisolone with disseminated Legionella pneumophila and true CMV coinfection: peripheral blood CMV DNA PCR was 300,000 copies/mL (E1 confirmatory), treated with IV ganciclovir.

evidence_items.source_quote: At age 4 months he was hospitalized for viral encephalitis, and at 12 months for pneumonia and sepsis, with positive Cytomegalovirus (CMV) viral load (2,020 copies/ml);

rationale: Immunocompromised infant (DNA Ligase IV deficiency, severe T-cell lymphopenia) hospitalized at 12 months with pneumonia and sepsis and positive quantitative CMV viral load (2,020 copies/mL; E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: positive CMV viral load, Acinetobacter baumanii cultured from blood, Enterococcus faecium from urine, and Enterobacter aerogenes from bronchial aspirate.

rationale: Immunocompromised female infant (DNA Ligase IV deficiency, severe T-cell lymphopenia) with recurrent pneumonia and sepsis and positive CMV viral load (E2 highly specific).

evidence_items.source_quote: The pathology report of partial gastrectomy revealed gastric perforation with severe CMV gastritis, ulceration, and foreign body-type giant cell reaction.

Immunohistochemistry staining using a monoclonal antibody against CMV pp65 antigen indicated CMV immunoreactivity with brownish areas (shown in Fig. 1). A nested-PCR confirmed CMV infection for CMV DNA in gall bladder specimens and gastric wall biopsy (shown in Fig. 2).
evidence_items.test_name: CMV pp65 IHC and nested PCR

rationale: 60-year-old woman with amphetamine/benzodiazepine overdose who developed fatal gastric perforation with severe CMV gastritis: confirmed by CMV pp65 immunohistochemistry on partial gastrectomy and nested-PCR for CMV DNA in gastric wall biopsy and gallbladder specimens (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: Cytomegalovirus (CMV) inclusion bodies showed positivity. After intravenous ganciclovir and methylprednisolone, the symptoms did not improve.

rationale: 51-year-old male with ulcerative colitis presenting with bloody diarrhea and fever. Colonic biopsy demonstrated positive CMV inclusion bodies (E1 confirmatory) and he was treated with IV ganciclovir.

evidence_items.source_quote: Vitreous DNA sequencing showed CMV sequence of 66,544 copies.

rationale: 54-year-old male with HIV on HAART who developed CMV immune recovery retinitis with retinal necrosis, hemorrhages, and vitritis, confirmed by vitreous DNA sequencing showing 66,544 CMV copies (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: Vitreous DNA sequencing showed a CMV sequence of 446,072 copies.

rationale: 40-year-old male with HIV on HAART who developed bilateral CMV immune recovery retinitis with retinal necrosis and vitritis, confirmed by vitreous DNA sequencing showing 446,072 CMV copies (E1 confirmatory) and treated with intravitreal ganciclovir.

evidence_items.source_quote: Vitreous DNA sequencing showed a CMV sequence of 60,527 copies.

rationale: 50-year-old male with HIV on HAART who developed bilateral CMV immune recovery retinitis with retinal necrosis and vitritis, confirmed by vitreous DNA sequencing showing 60,527 CMV copies (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: Vitreous DNA sequencing showed a CMV sequence of 206,679 copies.

rationale: 40-year-old male with HIV on HAART who developed CMV immune recovery retinitis in the left eye with retinal necrosis, hemorrhages, and vitritis, confirmed by vitreous DNA sequencing showing 206,679 CMV copies (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: She was found to have elevated CMV polymerase chain reaction in the blood (679 198 IU/mL) and spinal fluid (>2 000 000 IU/mL), as well as biopsy-proven CMV hepatitis (Figure 1).
evidence_items.test_name: Blood/CSF CMV PCR and liver biopsy

rationale: 61-year-old female 5 weeks post-liver transplant with confirmed disseminated CMV infection and CMV hepatitis: blood CMV PCR 679,198 IU/mL, CSF CMV PCR >2,000,000 IU/mL, and biopsy-proven CMV hepatitis (E1 confirmatory), resolved with IV ganciclovir prior to fatal toxoplasmosis.

evidence_items.source_quote: At day 83, the child was transferred to the pediatric intensive care unit; positivity for aspergillary and pan-fungal antigens together with the presence of CMV-DNA persisted.

Regarding the lung tissue, focal areas of necrosis, likely associated to Aspergillus infection (as confirmed by hyphae presence) and interstitial pneumonia evidence, consistent with CMV etiopathogenesis, were observed; hemorrhagic invasion of airspaces was also found (Figures 3B-E).
evidence_items.test_name: Lung autopsy histopathology and E-13 CMV IHC

rationale: Child (<6 years) with pre-B ALL and severe post-chemotherapy aplasia who developed persistent CMV-DNAemia, interstitial pneumonia on CT, received foscarnet, and had autopsy lung histopathology (with E-13 CMV immunoperoxidase) showing interstitial pneumonia consistent with CMV etiopathogenesis alongside Aspergillus laryngotracheitis (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: The consultant ophthalmologist reported fluffy lesions with diffuse retinal hemorrhage and patchy focal necrosis (brush fire pattern) in the right eye and normal left eye (Figure 1).

Real-time PCR was performed using an ABI Step One Plus System (Applied Biosystems, Foster City, CA) with standard reagents (TaqMan Gene Expression Master Mix, Applied Biosystems, UK), which showed positive results for CMV (5000 copy/ml).

rationale: 12-year-old boy with relapsed AML who developed acute visual loss with characteristic brush-fire CMV retinitis on fundoscopy, CMV blood PCR 950 copies/mL, and vitreous fluid quantitative CMV PCR 5,000 copies/mL (E1 confirmatory), treated with intravitreal and systemic ganciclovir.

evidence_items.source_quote: CMV reactivation with 7 x 104 copies/ml was detected on day +43.
Upon genotyping, mutation C325Y (cytosine at amino acid position 325 was substituted by tyrosine) was detected within UL56 which is supposed to confer high-level resistance to LMV.

rationale: 60-year-old female with AML post-allo-HSCT who developed high-level CMV reactivation (whole-blood PCR up to 1,000,000 copies/mL) and emergence of UL56 C325Y letermovir resistance mutation (E1 confirmatory), treated with ganciclovir, foscarnet, letermovir, and CMV hyperimmune globulin.

evidence_items.source_quote: On day +152 HSCT, the patient was still having positive CMV antigenemia and the previously taken colonic biopsy became positive for CMV (Fig. 1) so IV ganciclovir was replaced by IV foscarnet 60 mg/kg thrice daily.

rationale: 17-year-old male post-allo-HSCT with colonic GVHD, Salmonella, and confirmed CMV colitis: persistent positive CMV antigenemia and colonic biopsy positive for CMV (E1 confirmatory), treated with IV ganciclovir and IV foscarnet.

evidence_items.source_quote: A second external histology opinion was sought; this was reported as CMV duodenitis based on CMV inclusions in the biopsy. Treatment consisting of two weeks of intravenous ganciclovir followed by 450 mg valganciclovir and MMF cessation was instituted.

rationale: 45-year-old male SPK transplant recipient with Parvovirus B19 PRCA who also had biopsy-proven CMV duodenitis (CMV inclusions on duodenal biopsy, E1 confirmatory) treated with IV ganciclovir and valganciclovir.

evidence_items.source_quote: The results of further antibody tests revealed that he was positive for CMVpp65 antigens (C10, C11) 546/434.

Histopathological findings revealed a prominent ulcerative lesion containing numerous CMV-positive vascular endothelial cells scattered at the fundus of the ulcer (Figures 2 and 3). Based on these findings, the diagnosis of CMV infection was confirmed.

rationale: 82-year-old man on prednisolone and cyclosporine for membranous nephropathy who developed CMV-induced oral ulcers: strongly positive CMV pp65 antigenemia (546/434) and oral ulcer biopsy demonstrating numerous CMV-positive vascular endothelial cells (E1 confirmatory), treated with ganciclovir.

evidence_items.source_quote: until 9 years of age, when she developed CMV pneumonia that was successfully treated with intravenous ganciclovir, achieving negative CMV polymerase chain reaction (PCR) testing on follow up.
evidence_items.test_name: CMV pneumonia diagnosis and PCR clearance

rationale: 9-year-old girl with NFKB2-mutated CVID and NK cell defect who developed CMV pneumonia successfully treated with IV ganciclovir, achieving negative CMV PCR on follow-up (E2 highly specific).

evidence_items.source_quote: Quantitative CMV PCR was positive >2 x 106 copies/ml in blood and positive in a renal biopsy (not quantified in tissue).
evidence_items.test_name: Quantitative blood and renal biopsy CMV PCR

rationale: 12-year-old girl with NFKB2-mutated CVID who developed chronic systemic CMV infection with nephrotic syndrome: quantitative CMV PCR >2x10^6 copies/mL in blood, positive in renal biopsy and BAL, resistant to ganciclovir and treated with foscarnet and Cytogam (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: Moreover, histological analysis of an abscess in the right kidney showed three large cells with eosinophilic inclusion bodies suggestive of invasive CMV. Immunohistochemical analysis of this area found CMV antigen. In addition, quantitative PCR detected CMV DNA in blood (viral load: 20,900/ml) and in bronchoalveolar lavage fluid (viral load: 31,800/ml).
evidence_items.test_name: Renal histology/IHC and quantitative blood/BAL CMV PCR

rationale: 55-year-old man with CD4 lymphopenia, invasive amebiasis, aspergillosis, and invasive CMV coinfection: kidney histology showed eosinophilic inclusions with positive CMV IHC, plus quantitative CMV PCR in blood (20,900/mL) and BAL (31,800/mL) (E1 confirmatory), treated with ganciclovir.

evidence_items.source_quote: The karyotype was normal but CMV DNA was detected in the amniotic fluid.
They declined a postmortem, but histopathology of the placenta demonstrated extensive lymphocyte infiltration with occasional CMV inclusions suggestive of chronic villitis due to the virus.

rationale: 41-year-old pregnant woman with fetal echogenic bowel and progressive ventriculomegaly: maternal low-avidity CMV IgG/IgM, CMV DNA detected in amniotic fluid, and placental histopathology showing chronic villitis with CMV inclusions (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: Due to a positive test for cytomegalovirus DNA, the treatment regimen was switched to IV methylprednisolone (40 mg at 12-hour dosing intervals (q12h)) and foscarnet sodium (3 g q12h).
evidence_items.test_name: CMV DNA test and foscarnet therapy

rationale: 56-year-old male with AML post-haploidentical HSCT who had a positive test for cytomegalovirus DNA and was treated with foscarnet sodium alongside Rhizomucor pusillus pneumonia (E2 highly specific).

evidence_items.source_quote: Subsequently, thrombocytopenia was confirmed, CMV infection was suspected, and positive cells were detected in a repeated CMV antigenemia test.
After starting ganciclovir, CMV antigenemia was eliminated.

rationale: Giant cell arteritis with AA amyloidosis on steroid therapy; repeated CMV antigenemia test was positive and eliminated after IV ganciclovir therapy (E2 highly specific).

evidence_items.source_quote: The diagnosis was confirmed by the positivity of circulating CMV-DNA (6,080 IU/mL titer) and by duodenal histopathological findings (Figure 2b,c,d).

rationale: Severe COVID-19 complicated by CMV duodenitis and pancreatitis, confirmed by duodenal ulcers, circulating CMV-DNA (6,080 IU/mL), and duodenal histopathology, with viral load drop on ganciclovir (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: Aqueous humor biopsy showed presence of CMV infection (CMV DNA 230,400 UI/ml) while the presence of other viruses (herpes simplex virus, virus varicella zoster or Epstein Barr virus) was excluded; at the same time CMV serum DNAemia was negative.

rationale: Allogeneic HSCT recipient with whole-blood CMV DNAemia (37,000 IU/mL) and CMV retinitis confirmed by aqueous humor biopsy CMV DNA (230,400 IU/mL) (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: His serology was positive for CMV immunoglobulin M (IgM) and Immunoglobulin G (IgG) antibodies. CMV polymerase chain reaction (PCR) was positive with <2000 copies of deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA).
He was treated with ganciclovir for acute CMV viremia and received three doses of intravenous immunoglobulin without much response.

rationale: 18-year-old male with AIDP/GBS, hepatitis, and splenic infarct; CMV IgM/IgG and CMV PCR (<2000 copies) were positive and he was treated with ganciclovir for acute CMV viremia (E2 highly specific).

evidence_items.source_quote: One month after transplantation, the patient developed CMV infection coupled with pneumonia and retinitis.
evidence_items.test_name: clinical diagnosis with pneumonia and retinitis

evidence_items.source_quote: There was insufficient therapeutic improvement after combined antiviral therapy using ganciclovir, foscarnet sodium, and lyophilized IVIG for 6 weeks, with a significant increase in CMV DNA copy number compared with that before antiviral treatment (1.99 x 104 measured on 2019-04-07 vs. 4.01 x 103 measured on 2019-02-20).

rationale: Wiskott-Aldrich syndrome post-CBT complicated by CMV infection with pneumonia and retinitis, rising CMV DNA copy number (1.99 x 10^4), and improvement after NK cell infusion and intravitreal ganciclovir (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: CMV immunohistochemical staining was positive for CMV type inclusions compatible with CMV colitis (Figure 4).

rationale: 71-year-old man with relapsed AML and neutropenic enterocolitis; cecal biopsy CMV immunohistochemical staining was positive for CMV inclusions compatible with CMV colitis (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: As an early complication, cytomegalovirus (CMV) reactivation was detected on day + 24 and treatment with valganciclovir was initiated.

rationale: 6-year-old with preB-ALL post-allo-HSCT; CMV reactivation was detected on day +24 and valganciclovir was initiated during the current post-transplant course (E2 highly specific).

evidence_items.source_quote: He also developed persistent, nonbloody loose stools with negative bacterial and parasite stool studies so serum CMV PCR was checked on hospital day 43 showing 2,623,108 IU/mL.
Spinal fluid analysis was consistent with encephalitis and CSF PCR for CMV DNA was positive (Table 1).

rationale: 65-year-old male with HIV/AIDS (CD4 15); CMV identified on BAL viral culture, serum CMV PCR 2,623,108 IU/mL, CSF CMV DNA PCR positive with radiculomyelitis on MRI, treated with IV ganciclovir and valganciclovir (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: Her illness was further complicated by an episode of hypertensive encephalopathy and CMV meningoencephalitis along with CMV viremia requiring IV ganciclovir and then chronic oral valganciclovir therapy.

rationale: 15-year-old female with CVID and anti-GBM crescentic glomerulonephritis; illness complicated by CMV meningoencephalitis and CMV viremia requiring IV ganciclovir and chronic oral valganciclovir (E2 highly specific).

evidence_items.source_quote: A 70-year old woman, who received a deceased donor renal transplant in 2017, was treated with ganciclovir for CMV disease with ulcerative esophagitis.
evidence_items.test_name: clinical diagnosis and IV ganciclovir therapy

rationale: 70-year-old renal transplant recipient actively treated with IV ganciclovir for CMV disease with ulcerative esophagitis (E2 highly specific).

evidence_items.source_quote: A concomitant CMV infection prompted antiviral treatment, which in combination with higher target tacrolimus trough concentrations led to improvement and stabilization of kidney function in the follow-up.

rationale: 36-year-old kidney transplant recipient with ABMR; concomitant CMV infection prompted antiviral treatment leading to stabilization of kidney function (E2 highly specific).

evidence_items.source_quote: During the first half year, he developed biopsy-proven BK virus nephropathy (serum concentration: 441k cop/mL) and systemic CMV reactivation (140k cop/mL).
CMV reactivation was treatment resistant, and subsequent virus sequencing revealed UL97 resistance mutation, which led to prolonged virus clearance under hyperimmunoglobulin treatment.

rationale: 58-year-old kidney transplant recipient with systemic CMV reactivation (140k cop/mL) and virus sequencing confirming UL97 resistance mutation, cleared with hyperimmunoglobulin (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: A pathological autopsy revealed many intracellular inclusions from the jejunum to the rectum, indicating CMV enterocolitis and bone marrow hypoplasia (Fig. 2).

rationale: 69-year-old man with rectal cancer on capecitabine; autopsy revealed many intracellular inclusions from jejunum to rectum indicating CMV enterocolitis (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: The CMV antigen pp65 (antigenemia method of C10C11) was detectable at a level of 33 positive cells per 150,000 cells and 25 positive cells per 150,000 cells, which confirmed her diagnosis of acute CMV infection.

rationale: 35-year-old woman with fever, hepatitis, and splenic infarction; CMV IgM positive (4.60) and CMV pp65 antigenemia 33/150,000 cells, improving with IV ganciclovir (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: During the PICU stay, she had several respiratory complications, mainly recurrent lung infection: D1 - adenovirus and metapneumovirus (nasopharyngeal aspirate); D24 - cytomegalovirus (bronchoalveolar lavage); D40 - metapneumovirus (nasopharyngeal aspirate); D65 - Stenotrophomonas maltophila (bronchial aspirate).

rationale: 17-month-old girl in PICU with status epilepticus and ARDS; developed recurrent lung infection with cytomegalovirus detected in bronchoalveolar lavage on day 24 (E2 highly specific).

evidence_items.source_quote: At 1 month after stem cell transplantation, cytomegalovirus reactivation occurred, for which acyclovir was switched to valganciclovir (4 months), which resulted in by asymptomatic neutropenia, treated by intermittent use of G-CSF.

rationale: Allo-HSCT 11 months after lung transplant; cytomegalovirus reactivation occurred 1 month post-HSCT requiring switch from acyclovir to valganciclovir for 4 months (E2 highly specific).

evidence_items.source_quote: The diagnosis of tuberculosis and cytomegalovirus coinfection of the gastrointestinal tract was confirmed by the histopathological report (Ziehl-Neelsen staining of acid-fast bacilli, CMV intracytoplasmic inclusions in Giemsa staining, and immunohistochemical study with positive labeling for CMV in cells with clear halos), and some time later, culture with the growth of M. tuberculosis (Figure 3).
evidence_items.test_name: GI biopsy Giemsa inclusions and CMV IHC

rationale: 41-year-old man with HIV/HCV and GI TB-CMV coinfection confirmed by histopathology showing CMV intracytoplasmic inclusions on Giemsa and positive CMV immunohistochemistry, treated with IV ganciclovir for 21 days (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: Cytomegalovirus (CMV) DNA PCR of serum returned with 173,953 copies.
Immunohistochemistry was positive for CMV inclusions (Figure 1(d)).

rationale: 63-year-old woman with MCTD on high-dose steroids; serum CMV DNA PCR 173,953 copies, elevated CMV IgM/IgG, and leg ulcer biopsy showing characteristic CMV inclusions with positive CMV immunohistochemistry, improving rapidly on IV ganciclovir (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: These findings were morphologically consistent with a CMV infection and associated subacute cystitis, which was subsequently confirmed with positive CMV immunohistochemical stains (Figure 2). Her serum CMV viral load count was 113,383 IU/ml.
evidence_items.test_name: bladder biopsy CMV IHC and serum CMV viral load

rationale: 29-year-old pregnant woman with HIV and macroscopic hematuria; bladder biopsy showed viral cytopathy and positive CMV immunohistochemistry (subacute CMV cystitis) with serum CMV viral load 113,383 IU/mL, resolving on IV ganciclovir (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: Interestingly, the ophthalmologist suspected on sequential optical coherence tomography (OCT) scans a retinal neurodegenerative process resembling CMV retinopathy. evidence_items.test_name: quantitative blood CMV DNA PCR and OCT

rationale: 5-year-old female with medulloblastoma on maintenance chemotherapy and dexamethasone; developed blindness with OCT resembling CMV retinopathy, elevated blood CMV DNA on quantitative PCR, and normalization of LFTs and blood CMV DNA on oral valganciclovir (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: CMV PP65 antigen was positive (46 x 2/105) and CMV polymerase chain reaction (PCR) was positive (205 copies/ml). He was initiated on intravenous ganciclovir 250 mg daily.

rationale: Deceased donor renal transplant recipient; 3 months post-transplant developed fever, CMV pp65 antigenemia (46 x 2/10^5), and CMV PCR (205 copies/mL), treated with IV ganciclovir with PCR clearance (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: Torch series examination results showed that Toxoplasma gondii, herpes simplex virus 1 and 2, an rubella virus were negative, but human cytomegalovirus (HCMV) DNA was significantly higher than the normal range, and anticytomegalovirus lgG was positive.

rationale: 6-month-old infant with Aicardi-Goutieres syndrome 1 (TREX1) and elevated transaminases; HCMV DNA was significantly higher than normal with positive anti-CMV IgG (E2 highly specific).

evidence_items.source_quote: However, both the cytomegalovirus (CMV) and antibodies (IgG/IgM) were positive. So, ganciclovir was used to replace the amphotericin B and cefoperazone-sulbactam.
evidence_items.test_name: CMV and IgG/IgM with ganciclovir therapy

rationale: 22-year-old male with CADM and progressive ILD on CsA/steroids/CTX; both CMV and IgG/IgM antibodies were positive and ganciclovir was initiated (E2 highly specific).

evidence_items.source_quote: However, CMV immunoglobulin M (IgM) was 145 AU/ml (reference value: 0-29.9) and CMV immunoglobulin G (IgG) was 1.90 IU/L (reference value: 0.00-0.59). rationale: 62-year-old female with RA on methotrexate presenting with splenic infarct, PE, fever, and diarrhea; CMV IgM (145 AU/mL), low-avidity IgG (0.46), and quantitative CMV PCR (43,470 IU/mL) were positive, resolving on valganciclovir (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: The patient developed cytomegalovirus reactivation and BKV+ hemorrhagic cystitis are on days 24 and 32, respectively, which were controlled using antiviral drugs and intravenous immunoglobulin.

rationale: 6-year-old boy with Hb Bristol-Alesha post-haplo-HSCT; developed cytomegalovirus reactivation on day +24 controlled with antiviral drugs and IVIG (E2 highly specific).

evidence_items.source_quote: However, the patient showed a gradual decrease in the hemoglobin level to 8.7 g/dl on day 34, with subsequent discovery of cytomegalovirus (CMV) infection via colonoscopy biopsy and blood tests (a CMV viral load of 1,040,000 cp/ml was detected on day 42). evidence_items.test_name: colonoscopy biopsy and blood CMV viral load

rationale: 42-year-old male with SJS and vanishing bile duct syndrome; developed CMV colitis confirmed on colonoscopy biopsy and blood CMV viral load of 1,040,000 copies/mL, treated with ganciclovir (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: After recurrent urinary tract infections, the patient developed a septic shock and a cytomegalovirus (CMV)-associated pneumonia, forcing us to interrupt the bortezomib therapy.

rationale: 20-year-old woman with refractory anti-NMDAR encephalitis on bortezomib/rituximab/cyclophosphamide; developed CMV-associated pneumonia forcing interruption of bortezomib (E2 highly specific).

evidence_items.source_quote: On day 7, BAL fluid was positive for cytomegalovirus (CMV) by indirect fluorescent antibody testing and serum CMV IgG and IgM antibodies were detected by immunoassay, while CMV DNA of the blood remained negative.
evidence_items.test_name: BAL CMV IFA and serum IgG/IgM

rationale: 23-month-old girl with CDA type II and PAP; BAL fluid was positive for CMV by indirect fluorescent antibody testing with positive serum CMV IgG and IgM, treated with parenteral ganciclovir (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: Due to her severe diarrhea and cytomegalovirus (CMV) plasma viral load of 1823 IU/mL, intravenous ganciclovir was started for a presumed diagnosis of CMV colitis.
evidence_items.test_name: plasma CMV viral load and ganciclovir

rationale: 61-year-old kidney transplant recipient with disseminated MAC; plasma CMV viral load was 1,823 IU/mL and IV ganciclovir was administered, though colonic biopsies were negative for CMV colitis (E2 highly specific for CMV viremia).

evidence_items.source_quote: HCMV DNA (real-time PCR, Real Time Alert QPCR, Elitech Group Nanogen, Milan, Italy) was positive at 3434 copies/ml (sensitivity cutoff: >1111). Thus, acute HCMV hepatitis complicated with portal vein thrombosis was hypothesized.

rationale: 62-year-old female with acute HCMV hepatitis complicated by portal vein thrombosis; positive HCMV IgM (10.86), IgG (12.8), and real-time PCR HCMV DNA (3,434 copies/mL), clearing on IV ganciclovir (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: Serology revealed acute HCMV infection: IgM anti CMV (ELISA): 11.8 (negative < 0.9, positive > 1.1), IgG avidity test (ELISA): 18%, (low < 35, high >50). HCMV DNA (real-time PCR) was positive 100 copies/ml (cut-off >=100 copies).
evidence_items.test_name: HCMV IgM, low IgG avidity, and PCR

rationale: 20-year-old woman with portal vein thrombosis and acute primary HCMV infection confirmed by positive IgM (11.8), low IgG avidity (18%), and positive HCMV DNA PCR (100 copies/mL) (E2 highly specific).

evidence_items.source_quote: Infectious disease workup revealed anti-CMV IgM antibodies and CMV DNA (by PCR) in blood and urine.
evidence_items.test_name: blood and urine CMV DNA PCR and IgM

rationale: 9-week-old male with NPHS1 congenital nephrotic syndrome and concurrent CMV infection; anti-CMV IgM and CMV DNA PCR in blood and urine were positive and cleared after 1 month of valganciclovir (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: Further complications were: CMV reactivation (on day + 31) treated successfully with valganciclovir and osteonecrosis of the knees (on day + 138), treated with vitamin D, calcium, bisphosphonates, physio-kinesiotherapy and hyperbaric oxygen therapy.

rationale: DADA2 deficiency post-allogeneic HSCT; developed CMV reactivation on day +31 treated successfully with valganciclovir (E2 highly specific).

evidence_items.source_quote: Cytomegalovirus (CMV) IgM antibody detected by ELISA was positive in the child denoting recent infection which was later confirmed by polymerase chain reaction (PCR) method by detecting viral genome.

rationale: 2-month-old male with CMV-associated hemophagocytic syndrome; CMV IgM ELISA and CMV PCR were positive with bone marrow suppression (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: Bronchoalveolar lavage (BAL) fluid tested positive for Mtb DNA (2.79 x 103 copies/mL), cytomegalovirus (CMV) DNA (2.65 x 105 copies/mL), and Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) DNA (8.68 x 104 copies/mL) by real-time PCR analysis.

rationale: 8-year-old girl with thalassemia major post-HSCT; BAL fluid tested positive for CMV DNA (2.65 x 10^5 copies/mL) by real-time PCR, treated with ganciclovir, IVIG, and foscarnet (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: On day 79 post-transplantation, the patient was treated for CMV reactivation with IVIG.

rationale: 9-year-old boy with thalassemia major post-haplo-HSCT/UCB transplant; treated for CMV reactivation with IVIG on day +79 post-transplant (E2 highly specific).

evidence_items.source_quote: Pathologic examination of the rectal biopsy (Fig. 1) revealed an ulcerated rectal mucosa and a cytopathogenic effect with ballooned cells ("owl's eye") and cytomegalovirus inclusions. evidence_items.test_name: rectal biopsy histopathology and CMV IHC

rationale: 75-year-old man with COVID-19 treated with dexamethasone and anakinra; developed reactivated CMV proctitis confirmed by rectal biopsy owl's-eye inclusions, positive CMV immunohistochemistry, and blood CMV PCR (1,848 copies/mL), cured with oral valganciclovir (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: However, he developed cytomegalovirus infection and bone marrow suppression due to IVCY and valganciclovir, making the continuous administration of IVCY difficult.

rationale: 77-year-old man with EGPA on IV cyclophosphamide; developed cytomegalovirus infection requiring valganciclovir, forcing discontinuation of IVCY (E2 highly specific).

evidence_items.source_quote: Diarrhea developed at 2 months, and he was noted to be CMV PCR positive in blood. Therapy was initiated with valganciclovir.

rationale: Hispanic male infant with X-MAID (MSN) SCID; CMV PCR positive in blood at 2 months treated with valganciclovir/foscarnet, and foscarnet-resistant CMV reactivation after second HCT responding to CMV-specific CTLs (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: At 3 months after transplantation, despite a CMV infection treated with ganciclovir, renal function remained stable.

rationale: 50-year-old woman post-kidney transplant with AMR and TMA; developed CMV infection at 3 months treated with ganciclovir and subsequent CMV reactivation after eculizumab therapy (E2 highly specific).

evidence_items.source_quote: The infectious disease workup revealed CMV IgM and IgG in serum and CMV DNA in plasma at 41 IU/mL (reference value, undetected; quantification range, 35-106 IU/mL). Primary CMV infection was later confirmed by evidence of a low CMV IgG avidity index of 0.18 (cut off >0.7 for past infection).
evidence_items.test_name: CMV IgM, low IgG avidity, and plasma CMV DNA

rationale: 34-year-old male with primary CMV infection confirmed by serum CMV IgM/IgG, low CMV IgG avidity index (0.18), and detectable plasma CMV DNA (41 IU/mL), treated with oral valganciclovir (E2 highly specific).

evidence_items.source_quote: The results were positive for CMV-IgM and CMV-IgG and negative for hepatitis B surface antigen, hepatitis C, Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) viral capsid antigen IgM, EBV early antigen IgG, and parvovirus B19 IgM. To confirm whether or not it was an acute CMV infection, a PCR test for CMV (geni-Q) was performed using serum sample obtained on admission, and the tests revealed a positive result (200 copy/muL).

rationale: 19-year-old woman with DVT, PE, and alveolar hemorrhage from transient lupus anticoagulant triggered by acute CMV infection; CMV IgM/IgG and serum CMV PCR (200 copies/uL) were positive (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: On postoperative day 2, the vitreous PCR returned positive for CMV; all other tests were negative. The patient was switched from oral valacyclovir to valganciclovir 900 mg po twice daily.

rationale: 55-year-old male with multiple myeloma and right eye panuveitis/retinitis; vitreous biopsy PCR returned positive for CMV, treated with oral valganciclovir and intravitreal foscarnet with resolution (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: In October 2021, the patient experienced decreased vision in her left eye, and she was diagnosed with cytomegalovirus infectious retinitis.

rationale: 34-year-old female with myasthenia gravis on rituximab/prednisone; developed decreased vision in left eye diagnosed as cytomegalovirus infectious retinitis and treated with intravitreal ganciclovir (E2 highly specific).

evidence_items.source_quote: On day 66, cytomegalovirus pneumonia was observed; the patient was treated with ganciclovir, and he showed a mild recovery.

rationale: 10-month-old infant with JMML and OTCD post-cord blood transplant; developed cytomegalovirus pneumonia on day +66 treated with ganciclovir with mild recovery (E2 highly specific).

evidence_items.source_quote: Broncho-alveolar lavage fluid was PCR positive for CMV, but no other infectious source was identified. Her ganciclovir was switched to foscarnet with cytogam added to improve coverage.

rationale: 12-year-old with T-ALL post-second haploidentical HCT; developed CMV reactivation requiring ganciclovir and BAL fluid PCR positive for CMV, treated with foscarnet and cytogam (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: Additionally, she was diagnosed with cytomegalovirus (CMV) reactivation and BK virus hemorrhagic cystitis. She was placed on valgancyclovir (day 19) and Cidofovir (day 27) respectively.

rationale: 36-year-old female with AML post-allogeneic BMT; diagnosed with CMV reactivation on day +19 and treated with valganciclovir prior to day +41 PRES (E2 highly specific).

evidence_items.source_quote: CMV viral load (DNA quantitative) was found as 3311 IU/mL.

rationale: 46-month-old boy with PNP deficiency (p.Arg58Ter) and severe T-cell lymphopenia; quantitative CMV viral load was 3,311 IU/mL and patient received antiviral treatment (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: LP: CD3 76%, CD19 1.8%, CD4 59%, CD8 17%, CD3-CD16/56 20.8%, CD3+ HLA DR 75.3%, CMV viral load (DNA quantitative): 842 IU/mL.

rationale: 12-month-old girl with PNP deficiency (p.Arg234Ter) and severe T-cell lymphopenia; quantitative CMV viral load was 842 IU/mL and patient received antiviral treatment (E2 highly specific).

evidence_items.source_quote: On further evaluation, cytomegalovirus polymerase chain reaction (for cytomegalovirus) was found to be positive, although the serology for histopalsmosis was not performed owing to non-availability in our institution.

rationale: 26-year-old male with HIV (CD4 38), persistent fever, loose stools, and neuropathy; cytomegalovirus PCR was positive (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: Serological test for CMV ELISA was strongly positive for IgM antibodies. evidence_items.test_name: CMV pp65 antigenemia, IgM, and IgG seroconversion

rationale: 33-year-old man with Factor V Leiden and tibiopopliteal DVT; strongly positive CMV IgM ELISA, positive CMV pp65 antigenemia, and CMV IgG seroconversion confirming acute CMV infection (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: Serum virologic panel was strongly positive for HHV-6 (230,000 copies/mL) and CMV (5010 IU/mL); and slightly positive for EBV (500 cp/mL) and Parvovirus (<150 cp/mL).

rationale: 68-year-old male with DRESS syndrome and PTCL-NOS; serum virologic panel strongly positive for CMV at 5010 IU/mL (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: magenta-colored nuclear inclusions consistent with cytomegalovirus (CMV) infection which was confirmed by a positive CMV immunostain (Figure 3)

rationale: 47-year-old man with CNS lymphoma on dexamethasone; perianal skin biopsy showed CMV inclusions confirmed by positive CMV immunostain, serum CMV viral load 16,400 copies/mL, treated with IV ganciclovir/valganciclovir.

evidence_items.source_quote: The viral serologies showed elevated titers of Ig M antibodies to CMV, suggesting CMV infection. The CMV antigenemia test was also positive.

rationale: 22-year-old woman with SLE/HLH; elevated CMV IgM and positive CMV antigenemia test treated with ganciclovir (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: the CMV was 9.70x102 copies.

rationale: 55-year-old male post-renal transplant with polymicrobial pneumonia; CMV 9.70x10^2 copies, blood NGS HHV-5 654 reads, treated with ganciclovir.

evidence_items.source_quote: The detected reactivation of CMV particles (RT-PCR) both in the lung and blood motivated to give ganciclovir for 2 weeks (10mg/kg/day).

rationale: COVID-19 ARDS on VV-ECMO and methylprednisolone; CMV reactivation detected by RT-PCR in lung and blood, treated with ganciclovir for 2 weeks (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: On postnatal day 7, CMV polymerase chain reaction (PCR) was positive in the patient's blood; therefore, she was diagnosed as having a symptomatic congenital CMV infection.

rationale: Female neonate with symptomatic congenital CMV infection: positive blood CMV IgM, bilateral chorioretinitis, failed ABR, positive blood CMV PCR on day 7, treated with IV ganciclovir and oral valganciclovir.

evidence_items.source_quote: The simultaneously performed screening for EBV, HIV and CMV showed a former infection of EBV and an acute infection of CMV.

rationale: 35-year-old female post-cholecystectomy with acute hepatitis; screening showed acute CMV infection (antiviral omitted due to toxicity).

evidence_items.source_quote: Cytomegalovirus infection was diagnosed on day +21 (pp65 was found in 13 of 200,000 leukocytes), and treated with ganciclovir and foscarnet.

rationale: 45-year-old male with CML post-allogeneic PBSCT; CMV infection diagnosed on day +21 (pp65 in 13/200,000 leukocytes) and treated with ganciclovir and foscarnet (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: positive cytomegalovirus (CMV) antigenemia (41 cells/5 x 104 WBCs on the C7-HRP test).

rationale: 46-year-old man with TAFRO syndrome; positive CMV antigenemia (41 cells/5x10^4 WBCs on C7-HRP) and autopsy-confirmed systemic CMV infection involving lungs, pancreas, and adrenal glands (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: However, the cytomegalovirus antigen (PP65) was detected positive in blood. We then supplemented the treatment regimen with ganciclovir (500mg, orally tid) for anti-virus.

rationale: 61-year-old female with disseminated nocardiosis on methylprednisolone; blood CMV pp65 antigen detected positive and treated with oral ganciclovir (E1 confirmatory).

rationale: 12-year-old male with EBV-SMTs post-HSCT; developed low-level CMV DNAemia and post-HCT fatal CMV pneumonitis causing respiratory failure at D+32 (E2 highly specific).

evidence_items.source_quote: Lower endoscopy showed multiple ulcers in the rectum and the sigmoid colon, showing infection with CMV, as confirmed by CMV antigenemia (Figure 2).

rationale: 78-year-old female with RA/ANCA vasculitis after rituximab; rectosigmoid ulcers with CMV infection confirmed by CMV antigenemia and treated with ganciclovir (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: Since CMV antigenemia test (C7-HRP) was positive (15 of 50,000 white blood cells), ganciclovir (500 mg/d) was administered intravenously.

rationale: 76-year-old woman with t-FL post B-R; developed interstitial pneumonia with positive CMV antigenemia (C7-HRP: 15/50,000 WBCs), treated with IV ganciclovir, died of CMV pneumonia (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: The autopsy confirmed the presence of giant-cell pneumonitis that is typical for severe CMV infection (Figure 1).

rationale: SLE post-auto-HSCT; positive CMV antigen test on day +32, treated with valganciclovir/IV ganciclovir, died day +46 with autopsy-confirmed giant-cell pneumonitis typical for severe CMV infection (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: Cytomegalovirus (CMV) was detected (real-time PCR) in blood (2,730 copies/mL) and bronchoalveolar lavage (71,000 copies/mL)
evidence_items.test_name: blood and BAL CMV real-time PCR

rationale: Post-transplant persistent fever on day +58; CMV detected by real-time PCR in blood (2,730 copies/mL) and BAL (71,000 copies/mL), resolved after ganciclovir (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: During this period, the patient displayed persistent CMV DNA-emia despite antiviral treatment with ganciclovir and foscarnet.

rationale: 50-year-old female post-allo-HSCT with severe cGVHD; persistent CMV DNA-emia despite ganciclovir and foscarnet (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: However, the sample was positive for the presence of BKPyV and cytomegalovirus.

rationale: 45-year-old woman with AIDS (CD4 23); CSF PCR positive for cytomegalovirus (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: Excluding few episodes of asymptomatic Cytomegalovirus viraemia, easily managed with oral valganciclovir and temporary MMF minimization, she did not experience any significant complications

rationale: Kidney transplant recipient with aHUS; post-transplant Cytomegalovirus viremia managed with oral valganciclovir and MMF minimization (E2 highly specific).

evidence_items.source_quote: Cells of submucosal Brunner's glands showed nucleomegaly with eosinophilic intranuclear and basophilic cytoplasmic CMV inclusions (Figure 1(b)).

evidence_items.source_quote: Cytomegalovirus (CMV) viremia was noted on day -1 of HCT, when the weekly polymerase chain reaction (PCR)-based screening of viremia was started. Ganciclovir was started on day +2 of HCT.

rationale: 5-month-old girl with LAD-I post-haplo-HCT; weekly PCR detected CMV viremia on day -1, treated with ganciclovir starting day +2 until resolved on day +54 (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: We diagnosed the child of having bilateral eye CMV retinitis based on typical fundus features and history of treated CMV colitis.

rationale: 13-year-old child with combined T/B cell deficiency; bilateral CMV retinitis diagnosed on typical fundus features and prior HPE-confirmed CMV colitis, treated with 8 weeks IV ganciclovir (E2 highly specific).

evidence_items.source_quote: On D+101, the patient still had epigastric pain and pain in the oral cavity attributed to GVHD however the CMV antigenemia revealed 30 positive cells/200,000 leukocytes (Figure 1).

rationale: 34-year-old male post-allo-HSCT for B-ALL; CMV antigenemia revealed 30 positive cells/200,000 leukocytes on D+101, treated with IV ganciclovir (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: The patient had fever and CMV antigenemia as shown by 29 positive cells/200,000 leukocytes only on D+180 (Figure 1).

rationale: 50-year-old female post-allo-HSCT for MDS; fever and CMV antigenemia 29 positive cells/200,000 leukocytes on D+180, treated with IV ganciclovir (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: Pancreatitis was due  to the use of herbal medication and a cytomegalovirus infection (viral  load: 5472 U/L).

rationale: 41-year-old man with HIV stage 4 and acute pancreatitis attributed to herbal medication and cytomegalovirus infection with viral load 5472 U/L (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: pp65 antigen was also positive, and real-time polymerase chain reaction (PCR) confirmed the presence of CMV DNA.
evidence_items.test_name: CMV pp65 antigen and real-time PCR

rationale: 37-year-old man with CMV cholangiopathy; positive CMV IgM (780 U/ml) and IgG (350 U/ml), positive pp65 antigen, and positive real-time PCR for CMV DNA (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: The pathologist also identified CMV inclusions in the lungs, mediastinal adenopathies, thyroid gland, pancreas, and adrenal glands (Figure 2a). This observation was also confirmed by immunohistochemistry (Figure 2b).
evidence_items.test_name: autopsy histology, IHC, and BAL culture

evidence_items.source_quote: an AC tap was performed in the RE. PCR results were positive for CMV, but negative for HSV, VZV, EBV (Epstein-Barr virus), and also for human herpesviruses 6, 7 and 8.

evidence_items.source_quote: AC tap was performed, being positive for CMV and negative for all other herpesviruses.

rationale: 45-year-old male with hypertensive anterior uveitis; anterior chamber tap PCR positive for CMV, treated with topical ganciclovir (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: Results were positive for CMV DNA in aqueous humor, and for specific IgG anti-HSV, VZV and CMV in the serum.

rationale: 89-year-old woman with hypertensive anterior uveitis; aqueous humor PCR positive for CMV DNA, treated with topical ganciclovir (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: Herpes simplex virus (HSV) and Cytomegalovirus (CMV) inclusions were both present in the perianal biopsy (Figure 6).

rationale: 32-year-old woman with CD4 18 and perianal lesion; Cytomegalovirus inclusions present in perianal biopsy (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: Polymerase chain reaction (PCR) for TB and CMV was positive in the biopsy.

rationale: 32-year-old female post-renal transplant with colonic stenosis; colon biopsy PCR positive for CMV and TB, treated with valganciclovir for 4 weeks (E1 confirmatory).

evidence_items.source_quote: Pneumocystis jirovecii and CMV DNA were identified in the bronchoalveolar lavage by PCR. The patient was successfully treated with meropenem, trimethoprim/sulfamethoxazole, and ganciclovir.

evidence_items.source_quote: however, CMV antigen was positive (5 infected leukocytes per 2 x 105 leukocytes/mL). Therefore, it was concluded that the patient had a CMV infection, and the liposomal amphotericin B was discontinued.

evidence_items.test_name: CMV IgM/IgG and urine CMV DNA qPCR

evidence_items.source_quote: Aqueous tap was positive for CMV PCR.

evidence_items.source_quote: Blood PCR CMV was positive. Liver function tests noted the absence of hepatic cytolysis and cholestasis. The newborn received intravenous Ganciclovir  therapy.
